action.description: Form submit / Enter, send/post click, upload, … (policy is the core's).

chain.description: Delegation chain from the surface thread to the asking thread.

order.description: Per-surface presentation order; the lowest is the active card (P §8.5).

surfaceThreadId.description: Top-level chat that shows a sub-agent's request.

order.description: Per-surface presentation order; the lowest is the active card (P §8.5).

HostBrowserLiveControlParams.description: Params of `host/browser/liveControl` (core → host): a live-view control that is not page input. The page input itself goes as `host/browser/command{action:"input"}`. The result is null; a failure is a JSON-RPC error.

HostFileSnapshot.description: Result of `host/capture/fileSnapshot`: the picture of the file.

HostFileSnapshotParams.description: Params of `host/capture/fileSnapshot` (core → host). The core has already confined the path.

HostFilesTrashItemParams.description: Params of `host/files/trashItem` (core → host): the absolute path the core has already confined.

HostLocalPageUrlParams.description: Params of `host/localPage/url` (core → host); the result is the URL string.

idleSeconds.description: The OS's system idle time in seconds (`powerMonitor.getSystemIdleTime()`: input anywhere on the PC counts); `null` when the host cannot tell, which the caller treats as not active. The caller judges it against its own window (Node: 180 s).

supported.description: Whether this PC can show OS notifications (`Notification.isSupported()`).

rules.description: Chromium proxy rules for the URL (`DIRECT`, `PROXY host:port`, …).

confirmed.description: Node's `updaterInstall` argument `args[0]`: the user confirmed the install.

HostVisualizeCommandParams.description: Params of `host/visualize/command` (core → host): the loopback bridge's request body. The result is the service's object (`{text, tabs?, path?, …}`), `null` when it returns nothing (`visualizeCommand`: `(await visualize.command(…)) ?? null`).

LiveControlKind.description: What `host/browser/liveControl` carries to the viewed page.

oneOf.description: A phone's `resize-request`: `request` is its `resize` object (`{mode: "page"}` or `{mode: "fit-client", cssWidth, cssHeight, deviceScaleFactor}`); the host resizes the page (Node's `remote.resize(sessionId, request)`).
A phone's `ready.videoLimit`: `request` is `{maxWidth, maxHeight}`; the host may capture larger than its frame bound, up to it, and lock a new geometry (Node's `remote.widenVideo(sessionId, limit)`).

LocalPageScope.description: What a `host/localPage/url` lease covers; absent means `project`.

ModelProxyExecuteParams.description: Server core → a connection with `capabilities.modelProxy`: run one model call with this machine's accounts. Completion is the response; losing the connection resolves the call `cancelled`.

ModelProxyResult.description: A failed call answers with a JSON-RPC error whose data is a [`crate::v2::model_proxy::ProxyFailure`].

chain.description: Delegation chain from the surface thread to the asking thread.

order.description: Per-surface presentation order; the lowest is the active card (P §8.5).

surfaceThreadId.description: Top-level chat that shows a sub-agent's request.

oneOf.description: `Send` finished; its events came ahead of it.
`None` for a single-wire adapter or a model no offered wire serves.

providers.description: In the order the PC advertised them: a JSON object on the wire, whose key order Node keeps (the setup lists custom providers in it).

ready.description: Whether the PC's registry is loaded. An older PC omits it, and the server then reads the answer as loaded only when it names an enabled provider.

oneOf.description: `modelProxy/run` reports a failed call as its result: the error vocabulary of the server has no place for a [`ProxyFailure`]. The connection relays it to the server as the JSON-RPC error of `model/proxy/execute` whose data is the failure.

ProxyBinary.description: A file part's bytes. The sender's attachment-store reference means nothing on the PC, so it is never carried: the sender inlines the bytes (under its byte budget), and a reference that stays travels as `unavailable`.

ProxyCall.description: What the remote runtime asks of the PC's providers (`ModelProxyProvider`, `quota-reading.mjs:93`, `loadModelProxyProviderConfig`).

ProxyCustomReasoning.description: A custom provider's reasoning wire contract (``CustomReasoning``).

updates.description: `(message index, effort)` pairs; a JSON object would key them by text.

ProxyFailure.description: A failed call as the sender's retry and recovery read it (the classified `ProviderError`); credential-shaped text in the message is redacted and nothing else of the PC leaves it.

notices.description: The display-only notices the failed call raised before it failed (`ProviderError::notices`).

ProxyModel.description: A model the PC's provider lists, with the first-response budget of its catalog entry.

aliasTarget.description: The model a routing alias resolves to.

created.description: When the provider created the model (epoch seconds, as listed).

inputCostPerM.description: The row's own prices, USD per million tokens; absent when not finite.

manual.description: A custom model added by hand.

maxContextWindow.description: The largest window the listing states for the model.

mode.description: The kind of model the listing states (`chat`, `embedding`, ...).

name.description: The row's own `name`, the label when no display name is known.

providerName.description: A custom provider's own name for itself.

runtimeContextWindow.description: What a managed local runtime has allocated; bounds a selected window.

wire.description: The wire id(s) the picker id is sent under.

ProxyOptions.description: `RequestOptions` field for field. The connection scope and the model's output ceiling are the PC's to derive, so they are not carried.

ProxyOutcome.description: How the PC's broker ended a failed send.

oneOf.description: The retry verdict surfaced the error.
The PC's admission refused the call; the message says why.

ProxyParameterOption.description: A selectable non-effort, non-fast model parameter (``ParameterOption``).

ProxyParameterValue.description: One value of a picker parameter (``ParameterValue``).

ProxyPicker.description: What the model picker shows beyond limits and capabilities (``PickerFields``).

ProxyProviderInfo.description: What a server learns of one PC provider: usable or not, and its traits.

agent.description: An agent/tool session, or a send carrying tools.

legacy.description: A session that predates the wire table (`model-proxy-provider.mjs:193`).

ProxyTraits.description: The adapter traits of a PC provider its stand-in needs.

reasoningTokens.description: Absent when the provider reported none; an explicit 0 stays 0.

QuestionAnswer.description: One `ask_user` answer, aligned by index with the questions.

ScreenDisplaysParams.description: Params of `browser/screenDisplays` (a granted phone's request, Node's `browserRemoteScreenDisplays`) and of `host/screen/displays` (core → host): none. Both answer `RemoteScreenDisplaySummary[]` (`apps/desktop/src/shared/remote-webrtc.ts`), unchanged.

ToolApprovalDecision.description: Mixdog's `ToolApprovalDecision` without `device`: the core stamps the device from the answering connection (P §8.1). The result type of every approval server request.

answers.description: `ask_user` answers aligned with the questions; `null` = unanswered.

editedArgs.description: edit-and-approve: the edited text of the request's editable fields.

reply.description: `ask_user`: the composer message that answered the question.

response.description: Human-in-the-loop response; a secret value never travels here (`approval/provideSecret`).

scope.description: Permission requests: the chosen scope id.

order.description: Per-surface presentation order; the lowest is the active card (P §8.5).

request.description: The card content (tool input, editable fields, reason).
